base.scope: The introducing commit's only source file is pi-extension/src/index.ts (73 changed lines), so no narrowing was needed. Generated pi-extension/dist files are omitted; the repository build reproduces the committed output, and the tests were run on that build. The fix also changes pi-extension/src/runtime/runtime-context.ts; that file is in the seeded variant only, because the introducing commit does not change it.

real.defect: In a configured session with no conversation or routing entries, the controller is left undefined. The status path then reports the routing runtime as 'cognitive blocked · runtime_inactive', although the runtime has not started yet. The fix shows 'cognitive standard · pending' for this state, and it also changes the setModeStatus signature in runtime-context.ts.
real.contributing_location: pi-extension/src/runtime/runtime-context.ts, setModeStatus: an effective routing config with no runtime reports 'runtime_inactive' as its fallback reason. The introducing commit does not change this function.
